description: This file defines a repository interface for the NotificationQueue entity, utilizing Spring Data JPA. It includes a custom query method for fetching pending notifications with concurrency control.

classes.name: NotificationQueueRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for NotificationQueue with custom query method to find pending notifications.

methods.name: findPendingBatch
methods.description: Fetches a batch of pending notifications scheduled to be sent, applying a pessimistic write lock to prevent concurrent processing.
